create_nested_tensor: create a NestedTensor object from a PyTorch tensor and an optional boolean mask tensor
nested_tensor_to_device: move a NestedTensor and its mask to a specified device like cuda or cpu
nested_tensor_decompose: decompose a NestedTensor into its underlying tensors and mask components
build_nested_tensor_from_list: build a NestedTensor from a list of 3D image tensors by padding to uniform batch size
check_distributed_initialized: check if PyTorch distributed is available and initialized for multi-GPU training
